stages.headline: A rectangular box is a parallelepiped whose lateral edges are perpendicular to a rectangular base; all its faces are rectangles.
stages.headlineEnglish: A rectangular box is a parallelepiped whose lateral edges are perpendicular to a rectangular base; all its faces are rectangles.

stages.headline: The square of the diagonal of a box equals the sum of the squares of its three dimensions: d² = a² + b² + c².
stages.headlineEnglish: The square of the diagonal of a box equals the sum of the squares of its three dimensions: d² = a² + b² + c².

stages.headline: Example: 3, 4, 12 ⇒ d = √(9 + 16 + 144) = 13; the four diagonals of a box are equal.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: 3, 4, 12 ⇒ d = √(9 + 16 + 144) = 13; the four diagonals of a box are equal.
